questions.question: The prophet Jeremiah warned Judah about not listening to the LORD. What did he say he would do if they refused?

answers.text: Weep in secret because of their pride
Leave Jerusalem and never come back
Stop bringing them the LORD's word

questions.question: Jeremiah asked if the Ethiopian can change his skin or the leopard his spots. What was he saying about Judah?

answers.text: They can't do good when they're used to evil
They will change once the trouble comes
They are no worse than the other nations

questions.question: The LORD told Judah that being scattered was their lot. What reason did He give for it?

answers.text: They forgot Him and trusted in falsehood
They doubted Him and trusted in Egypt
They envied the nations and trusted in armies

questions.question: After the LORD said "Woe to you" to Jerusalem through Jeremiah, what did He ask the city?

answers.text: How long it will remain unclean
Why it went back to Egypt
